LAW SOCIETY OF IRELAND

Private & Confidential Michael Gavin Dundonnell Taughmaconnell Co Roscommon

12 August 2015

Our Ref: 22942/L/19/7 and 22943/L/19/7 (please quote our reference on all correspondence)

Dear Mr Gavin,

Despite the fact that both the above enquiry files have been closed, I continue to receive letters and emails from you. I refer in particular to your letter of 26 July, and also you lengthy email of 30 July 2015.

You have referred one of these matters to the Independent Adjudicator, and I believe that she has upheld the Society's decision to reject your complaint. In the circumstances, there is little point in your sending further correspondence and emails to me, and such further correspondence will not receive a reply. Indeed, if you continue to send emails to the Society, I will have no alternative but to block your email address. I do hope that that will not prove necessary.

Yours sincerely

Tony Watson Solicitor Deputy Head of Complaints and Client Relations Section Fax 01 879 8785 email complaints@lawsociety.ie
